component.name: rulertoo
component.summary: On-screen ruler with real physical dimensions

description.p: Borderless on-screen ruler for X11 that uses real physical millimetre sizes reported by XRandR (not a global DPI assumption). Place it on any monitor and it scales correctly to that panel.
Features classic mm / 5 mm / cm marks, horizontal or vertical orientation, free-end resize, unit cycling (cm, mm, inch, pixel), and a shift of the numbering origin.
